facts.text: I ruminate on whether vampires being more active has to do with a “master” referenced in a note.
I believe the master caused my spell to fail with the demon allowing him to escape.
I decide that I need to talk to someone higher on the food chain to figure out what is going on.
I ask what other friends I could ask for help from.
I think Michael and Thomas could help me the most.
I send messages to Michael and Thomas to meet me at the local crypt.
I head over to meet Michael and Thomas at 3pm prompt.
I need a cold drink before meeting Michael and Thomas.
I had a busy morning killing demons.
I think there might be useful information from the bar keep.
I think my werewolf friends will have an idea about the local gangs.
My werewolf friends keep to the streets.
I head over to see what my werewolf friends are up to.
